description.value: On the Run is a 24-hour Chevron-affiliated convenience store on Alaska Road North in Fort Saint John, a key route for cyclists heading into or out of northeastern BC. The store offers convenience goods alongside fuel (94 octane and diesel), making it a practical resupply stop in a region where services can be sparse. It accepts cash, credit, debit, and contactless payment.
